title: Emoji-status switch moves before the send and is not put back when the send fails
trigger: Open a mini app's permission box, flip 'allow emoji status' while the client cannot send (closing, native send error).
effect: The bot's can_manage_emoji_status stays flipped though no request went out and no error answer will ever restore it (apply_web_app_error is the only rollback).
fix: Stage the change as a pending request with a RequestRollback (as set_forum_topic_muted does), or flip only after a successful send.

title: A new launch clears the unconsumed open result without closing the app TDLib already started
trigger: Open mini app A; its answer lands in open_result as Opened{launch_id}; before the UI poll takes it (or while its window is locked/refused) open mini app B.
effect: mark_web_app_pending sets open_result=None (and finish_web_app_open overwrites it) without pushing A's launch_id to dropped_launches, so closeWebApp is never sent for A and the bot keeps a live session.
fix: Make open results a per-request map or queue keyed by RequestId, and route every discarded Opened through dropped_launches.

title: Mini-app launch is a Vec of pending contexts plus single one-shot Option slots
trigger: n/a
effect: Launch stage is spread over WebApps::pending, open_result, dropped_launches and the one-shot found/write_access/emoji_access/phone_share/data_sent/attachment_menu_* slots, each cleared by hand at the start of the next call.
fix: One enum per flow (Launch{Pending(RequestId,ctx)|Opened|Failed|Dropped}) keyed by request id; grossing_loading becomes Fetch<Vec<i64>>.

title: Transfer-card lookup answer is not matched to the transaction that was asked for
trigger: In the open Money page click a transfer card for transaction A, then another card for transaction B before A answers.
effect: tx_loading is one bool and the Transaction answer is matched by purpose only, so A's answer shows A's details and clears tx_loading; B's answer is then dropped. The user sees the wrong transfer.
fix: TxLookup enum {Idle, Loading(tx_id), Failed(id, text)} and apply the answer only when its id equals the Loading id.

title: Wallet one-shot request flags are set before the send and some are never cleared on failure
trigger: Open the Money page while the send fails (state_requested/rates_requested stay true), or while getApplicationConfig is refused by TDLib.
effect: state_requested and rates_requested stay true after a failed send, and explorer_url_requested has no error arm at all, so the Gram USD rate and explorer address are never asked again this session and the fiat value shows a dash.
fix: Fetch<T> per resource (rates, explorer config, own state) with Failed re-askable on the next Money page open.

title: Paged<T> and MoneyPage keep loading/loaded/error as separate fields
trigger: n/a
effect: History and NFT lists carry loading, loaded and error that apply()/fail() keep in step; MoneyPage::close/open resets the whole page while an earlier page request is still in flight, so its late answer lands in the new page (append onto an empty list).
fix: Paged<T> holds a Fetch-like enum (Idle/Loading{append}/Ready/Failed) and a page token compared with the answer.

title: Re-requesting insights while statistics are in flight fetches the first forwards page again and appends it
trigger: Open insights for own story A; its forwards page answers first; reopen insights for A while getStoryStatistics is still pending.
effect: The pending-stats branch sees no forwards request in flight and calls fetch_story_public_forwards(offset empty); accept_public_forwards extends the list, so the first page of public forwards shows twice.
fix: Ask for the first page only when the forwards fetch is Idle; make forwards a Fetch with the offset it was asked for and replace on offset 0.

title: A failed send of the next search page throws away all search results
trigger: Scroll a public story search to its end and trigger Load more when the sender refuses the request.
effect: send_story_search_page calls clear_story_search on any send error, so the open results panel and its pages vanish instead of showing a retryable error.
fix: On a send error settle the page as Failed (search.error, loading cleared) and keep the pages.

title: Story insights and search state kept as loading bool plus error plus request
trigger: n/a
effect: StoryInsightsState has forwards_loading beside forwards_error; StorySearchState has loading beside error and an Option<RequestId> that is the real stage; load_more flips loading before the send decides whether a request goes out.
fix: StorySearchState::page: Fetch{Idle|Loading(RequestId)|Failed}; same for forwards.

title: Staged close-friends list is one Option not matched to the request
trigger: Save the close-friends list twice quickly (A then B) and let the first request fail.
effect: close_friends_pending holds only the latest list; A's error clears B's staged ids, so B's ok applies nothing and the list on screen stays stale although the server has B.
fix: Stage the list on the PendingRequest (or a map by RequestId) and apply it on that request's ok.

title: Story viewers panel loading flag is set after the send by the driver
trigger: n/a
effect: StoryViewersState::loading/error/next_offset are kept in step with the GetStoryInteractions request by the driver and two reducer arms.
fix: Fetch-style enum with the offset requested, set in one place.

title: Suggest bar is removed as soon as the send goes out, before the answer
trigger: Edit a suggested post with new price/time, send the change, and let TDLib refuse it (balance, permissions).
effect: The bar (terms the user set) is dropped on send success; the error arm only adds a note, so the terms must be entered again.
fix: Keep the bar until the request answers; remove it in the ok arm and keep it on error.

title: Proxy auto-switch and system-proxy follow run only for the account on screen
trigger: Sign in two accounts, set Use system proxy (or a proxy list with rotation) on account B, switch to account A, then change the OS proxy or kill B's proxy.
effect: The Background tick scope returns before proxy_tick/system_proxy_tick, so B's TDLib client keeps the dead or old proxy, stops receiving messages and notifications until B is shown again.
fix: Run proxy_tick and system_proxy_tick for both scopes (they are per-driver), keep only UI-bound ticks on-screen.

title: Video-note story reply runs ffmpeg synchronously on the UI thread
trigger: Record a round video as a story reply and press Send (ui/story_viewer/reply_media.rs:457 calls this inside this.update_in).
effect: write_video_note_thumbnail waits for ffmpeg (up to PROBE_LIMIT*3 = 30 s) on the main thread; the whole window freezes during the wait, and with a hung ffmpeg for half a minute.
fix: Make the thumbnail with the capture finish on the background task and pass it in the draft; the driver only sends.

title: parameters_sent bool shadows the auth state it follows
trigger: n/a
effect: ConnectDriver::parameters_sent is set after setTdlibParameters is sent and gates both maybe_send_parameters and network_tick; the real stage is session.auth (WaitTdlibParameters, StartupFailed on error), so two values are kept in step.
fix: Handshake enum {NotSent, Sent(RequestId)} owned with the auth state, or derive from auth and the pending SetParameters request.

title: Draft save is a clock, a token, and an Option that must change together
trigger: n/a
effect: draft_clock, draft_save_token and pending_draft (token, chat, topic, content) are updated by hand in several driver methods; same shape for search_debounce_token with pending_typed_search and chat_search_debounce_token with pending_typed_chat_search.
fix: A Debounce<T> value {Idle|Armed{token,value}} that owns the token.

title: Thread open stage is status plus needs_chat_switch, reading_started and reload_needed
trigger: n/a
effect: ThreadView::status, needs_chat_switch, reading_started and reload_needed are set in step by switch_to_thread_chat, begin_thread_reading, fetch_thread_history and the reducer; the UI polls thread_needs_start each frame to decide which step is due.
fix: ThreadStage enum {Resolving, SwitchingChat, Starting, Loading, Ready, Failed} with reload as a Ready sub-variant.

title: Auto-download prefs: seeded bool beside an external loading flag and an error
trigger: n/a
effect: 'Loading…' is derived from DataStoragePrefs::seeded plus SettingsState::auto_download_presets_loading plus data_storage_error; storage_limits_seeded is a second one-way stage flag.
fix: Fetch<DataStoragePrefs> for the presets seed; persist only the seeded values.

title: Ninth queued external link is dropped silently and reported as accepted
trigger: While the UI is busy or locked, open nine different tg:// links from the OS.
effect: push_external_link returns true and raises the window, but links past MAX_QUEUED are not queued; the user gets no word that the link was ignored.
fix: Return a result enum {Queued, Duplicate, Full} and tell the user when the inbox is full.

title: JoinBox.joining and RevokeBox.sending are stage bools next to the box Option
trigger: Join Program or Revoke Link clicked, then the answer or error arrives
effect: Box stage is held as a bool beside the Option, reset by hand in connect/earn.rs and the error arm of state/domains/payments/earn.rs
fix: enum JoinStage { Choosing, Joining(RequestId) } and RevokeStage { Asking, Sending(RequestId) }, so an answer is matched to its request id and cannot clear a newer box

title: WithdrawStep::Password carries sending: bool and error: Option<String> that can both be set
trigger: Submit the 2FA password of a Stars or TON withdrawal
effect: sending and error are kept in step by hand in connect/earn.rs and apply_withdrawal_error
fix: Split into Password { error: Option<String> } and PasswordSending; the sending stage carries the request id

title: Recipients load is a u8 counter plus Option list plus parked join box
trigger: Open a program with choose_recipient, or the bot profile Affiliate Program row
effect: recipients_loading (counts two requests down), recipients (None or Some) and pending_join must change together across connect/earn.rs and the payments reducer
fix: enum Recipients { Idle, Loading { chats: Pending, bots: Pending, join: Option<JoinBox> }, Ready(Vec<EarnPeer>), Failed }

title: One failed send of the two recipient requests caches a partial recipient list for the session
trigger: Open an affiliate program as the user while the chats send works and the bots send fails (or the reverse, e.g. a send error between the two)
effect: request_earn_recipients resets recipients_loading to 0 and recipients to None and returns Err, but the request that did go out still answers: add_earn_recipients makes recipients Some(me + channels). From then on recipients.is_some() makes request_earn_recipients return early, so owned bots (or channels) are never offered as commission recipients until the account is reopened
fix: Recipients enum with a Failed stage that ignores late answers of the abandoned attempt (match by request id) and allows a retry

title: balances_asked is pushed before the request is sent and never cleared on failure
trigger: Open a channel or bot profile while the send fails or the TON/Stars balance request errors (apply_earn_error ignores TonBalance and StarBalance)
effect: The peer stays in balances_asked, so fetch_earn_balances returns early forever; the profile Monetization or Stars row never shows its balance this session. Also the Vec is a started flag with no way back
fix: HashMap<EarnPeer, BalanceFetch> with Asking(RequestId) / Known / Failed, cleared on error so a reopen asks again

title: open_earn_page leaves ton and stars in Loading when a later send fails
trigger: Open Monetization or Stars Balance and a send_earn returns Err (client closing, send error): the first `?` returns after the page was stored with ton/stars = Loading
effect: The page spinner stays; stars Load::Loading is never settled because no request was sent for it (only TON history gets inspect_err). The UI shows a toast but the page itself never leaves loading until it is reopened
fix: Set Load::Loading only after the send succeeds, or on Err set both Loads to Failed

title: Program list answers are not matched to the sort or offset that asked
trigger: Scroll the programs list (an append page is in flight) then change Sort by; or change Sort twice quickly
effect: set_starref_sort resets join.found, but SearchPrograms{for_box,append} answers carry no sort/offset/request id: an older answer that lands after the newer one (or an old append landing on the fresh list) shows programs in the old order with the old next_offset, and later pages continue from the wrong offset
fix: Carry the RequestId (or a list generation) in ProgramList::load = Loading { request } and apply only the answer of that request

title: Connect/ConnectedProgram answers act on whatever box is open now, not the one that asked
trigger: Click Join Program, close the box or open another program, then the first answer arrives; or click two programs quickly
effect: Connect clears join_box and opens a link box for the old program over the new join box; the ConnectedProgram answer for program A can replace the join box or link box opened for B
fix: Store the RequestId in the box stage and ignore answers whose id is not the box's

title: notes toast queue of a background account is shown only after switching back
trigger: A SetProgram / Connect / Disconnect / stats request fails or finishes while another account is on screen
effect: Session.payments.earn.notes is drained by drain_earn only for the on-screen live client, so the 'Failed: ...' or 'Affiliate program ended' toast appears later, unrelated to what the user is doing
fix: Toasts go through the owning account's status path at the time of the answer, or are dropped when the account goes to the background

title: setup_closed is a one-shot bool next to setup: Option
trigger: Save or End the affiliate program
effect: The reducer sets setup=None and setup_closed=true; the UI consumes the bool in drain_earn and open_starref_setup resets it by hand
fix: Return the 'go back' effect from the reducer as an event (EarnEffect::SetupDone) instead of a latched bool

title: EarnPage.ton_unavailable bool beside ton: Load
trigger: BROADCAST_REQUIRED for a megagroup
effect: The reducer sets ton_unavailable=true and resets ton to Idle; Load has no 'not applicable' stage so the page needs the extra bool
fix: Add a Load::Unavailable stage (or Option<Load>)

title: EarnLimits.app_config_loaded is a 'asked once' flag with two writers
trigger: Open any profile or earn page
effect: The flag is set by the groups reducer on success and by the earn error arm, and ensure_earn_app_config also checks an in-flight GetBoostsPerGift; a failed send is never recorded so it is retried on every call
fix: Fetch<AppConfig> from src/state/fetch.rs

title: EmojiPanel holds many stage flags kept in step by hand
trigger: Open Emoji Sets, the status picker or the chat Appearance box
effect: open, failed, mutation_failed, mutating_set, status_open, chat_status_open, status_note, pending_status_emoji, trending_stale, sticker_categories_asked and installed_loaded are written from connect/emoji_sets.rs, the stickers error arm and ui/emoji_sets.rs; failed is shared by the Installed, Trending and Search tabs
fields: EmojiPanel::open, EmojiPanel::failed, EmojiPanel::mutation_failed, EmojiPanel::mutating_set, EmojiPanel::status_open, EmojiPanel::chat_status_open, EmojiPanel::status_note, EmojiPanel::pending_status_emoji, EmojiPanel::sticker_categories_asked
fix: Per-tab Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> and a single enum for the status/appearance consumers; mutating_set as Option<Mutation{request,set,install}>

title: status_open stays set after an account switch with the status picker open
trigger: Open the emoji status picker (Premium status), switch account without closing it
effect: OnScreen is replaced whole, so pickers.media_panel.panel_mode resets without set_media_panel_mode, and PickerUi's Farewell is empty (ui/pickers_state.rs:107); close_emoji_status_choices is never called for the retired account. Its Session keeps status_open=true in the background, so every envelope of that hidden client runs maybe_resolve_emoji_status_choices and keeps resolving status choices; on switch back the flag is set with the picker closed
fix: Add a Farewell for the media panel that calls close_emoji_status_choices, or derive 'resolving statuses' from the panel mode instead of a Session flag

title: Swept searchEmojis requests free their slot without counting a failure
trigger: A searchEmojis request is dropped by the stale sweep (offline, TDLib never answers)
effect: retain_in_flight removes the entry but failures[query] is not incremented, so wants(query) stays true and the same query is asked again after every sweep instead of stopping after ATTEMPTS; failures also grows by one entry per failing query for the session
fix: Make retain_in_flight call failed() for each removed request

title: Messages marked watched while the pack loads never play if the pack load fails
trigger: An incoming lone emoji is read before the EmojiAnimations pack arrives and searchStickerSet fails
effect: autoplay_emoji_effects calls mark_watched(key) before wait(); failed() clears the waiting queue, so those messages are already watched and never play their effect this session, even after the two hour retry loads the pack
fix: Mark watched only when the effect is queued, or keep waiting messages across a failed attempt

title: EmojiAnimations load stage is split between load, ready and waiting
trigger: Open a private chat that receives a lone emoji
effect: ready (bool) is set by apply_set, load by loading()/apply_set()/failed(), and waiting is cleared only by failed(); a lost request (never answered and not swept as an error) keeps Loading for two hours (load_due) with ready false
fix: enum Pack { Never, Loading{since,waiting}, Ready{asked,map}, Failed{asked} } so waiting lives only in Loading

title: DiskState::confirmed takes the 'armed once' bool from the caller
trigger: Disk free space falls below the close floor
effect: DiskState, below_once (DiskUi::confirming), screen_refused, held_for_call and start_refused (ui/disk_state.rs) together describe one disk stage but are separate fields; DiskClients is rebuilt from them each reading
fix: enum DiskStage { Healthy, Low, FullPending, Full { held_for_call }, Refused } owned by DiskUi, with confirmed() a method on it

title: Emoji set row state is derived from five separate fields of EmojiStyleUi
trigger: Settings, Choose emoji set: click Noto while another set downloads or failed
effect: SetState::of(id, current, ready, loading, failed) is recomputed from current, ready, download, failed and file_error that download_emoji_set, switch_emoji_set and install_emoji_set_file update by hand (ui/emoji_style_ui.rs)
fix: Store SetState per EmojiSetId in the UI (HashMap<EmojiSetId, SetState>) and mutate it only by transitions

title: Two quick set switches can leave the saved choice different from the drawn set
trigger: Click Noto then Twemoji (both downloaded) within one frame
effect: switch_emoji_set stores each switch in the single switch_task slot; the older task is dropped but its background load_state + save_current(Noto) can still run after save_current(Twemoji), so 'current' on disk is Noto while Twemoji is drawn; next launch shows the other set
fix: Serialize the switch: one SwitchStage enum with the target set; apply only the latest and save on the UI side after applying

title: A timed-out export request leaves WorkerLink::pending set, so its late answer is handed to the worker's next call
trigger: Run a full account export with several chats; one chat's getChatHistory/searchChatMessages/download takes over 300 s (QUERY_TIMEOUT) to answer. ChannelTdlib::call returns Tdlib("the request timed out"), export_chats counts that chat as failed and carries on (account/worker.rs:482). The driver still has pending=Some(A) and forwards nothing else; when A's answer arrives WorkerLink::reply sends it down the id-less replies channel, where the next chat's first call takes it as its own answer.
effect: The next chat is exported with the previous chat's messages (or every later answer is shifted by one), so a chat folder holds another chat's content under the wrong name; later calls misparse until the export ends.
fix: Make the reply channel carry the RequestId and have ChannelTdlib::call discard replies that are not its own request; on timeout also clear/abandon the link's pending entry (an enum ExportCall {Idle, Awaiting(RequestId), Abandoned(RequestId)}).

title: WorkerLink lifecycle is spread over pending: Option<RequestId>, an AtomicBool cancelled and an 'ended' channel whose disconnect means done
trigger: Any chat or account export: running() = !cancelled && !ended, idle_or_cancelled() = pending.is_none() || cancelled, and the UI separately reads Progress.stage (Finished/Failed/Cancelled) written by the worker thread.
effect: Four independent signals (link.pending, link.cancelled, link.ended, progress.stage) must agree; they disagree after a worker panic or a request timeout (see 03-P3-001 and 03-P3-003).
fix: One ExportRun enum owned by the session (Starting, Running{awaiting}, Cancelling, Ended(outcome)) written by the pump and by a worker-ended notice, with progress as data inside Running.

title: An export worker that panics ends without publishing a settled stage; the progress box never gets Done
trigger: The account (or chat) export worker thread panics inside spawn_guarded (any future indexing/unwrap bug, or the debug_assert in ResultJson::field in debug builds). guarded() swallows it, the closure's trailing publish(Failed) never runs, only the alive sender drops.
effect: Progress stays at e.g. 'Chats: 3 of 40' for ever, the Done button (only shown when settled) never appears, a new export is refused with 'already running', and every Quit shows 'Stop and quit?'. worker_ended() is not read anywhere outside tests to settle it.
fix: Settle on worker end: a drop guard in the thread body that publishes Failed('stopped unexpectedly') when no final stage was written, or poll worker_ended() and map it to a Failed stage.

title: A failed or cancelled account export leaves a truncated, unterminated result.json and no export_results.html
trigger: Start a JSON-format account export of many chats, press Cancel (or lose the connection so a section call fails) midway.
effect: The DataExport folder keeps result.json cut off mid-array (ResultJson::finish and the index page are only written on the success path), so a later tool reading it fails or silently sees a partial export, and the folder holds private account data with no marker that it is incomplete.
fix: On Err/Cancel finish the ResultJson (close arrays) or write an 'incomplete' marker; better, write to result.json.part and rename on success.

title: Two installs of the same emoji set share one temp folder and one .old folder, so overlapping installs corrupt each other
trigger: Start downloading set X, press Download X again (the first download is cancelled but its worker is already inside unpack), or run 'Install from file' for X while a download of X is finishing.
effect: Both unpack calls use '.<name>.<pid>.part' and '.<name>.old': one remove_dir_all wipes the other's half-extracted files, so the install fails with 'damaged'/'Couldn't save' or the .old rollback restores the wrong pack.
fix: Name the temp folder with a per-call serial (as copy::part_path does) or serialise installs per EmojiSetId.

title: EmojiStyleUi keeps the download stage as started: bool plus download, download_task, failed, file_task and file_error Options, and detects cancel by comparing the message to "Cancelled."
trigger: Open Emoji set, start a download, start another (replaces it), install from file while one runs.
effect: download/download_task/failed/file_error must be cleared together by hand in download_emoji_set, install_emoji_set_file and the completion callbacks; the cancel arm is recognised by a string equal to download::fetch's literal.
fix: enum SetStage {Idle, Downloading{id, progress, task}, Failed{id, message}, Installing{task}} and a typed DownloadError::Cancelled instead of String.

title: A flood-retry re-send that fails drops an export request via settle_lost_request, which never clears the export link's pending
trigger: During an export a getChatHistory gets a 429 (retained and retried), and the re-send's send_json fails (TDLib closing / connection teardown).
effect: settle_lost_request feeds a generic error to the reducer, not to WorkerLink::reply, so link.pending stays Some(id): idle_or_cancelled() is false and no further export request is forwarded; the worker waits out QUERY_TIMEOUT per call.
fix: Route ExportAccount/ExportChat/ExportRichHtml lost requests to link.fail_send (or reply with an error) in settle_lost_request.

title: FilterDraft::open drops stored administrators that are no longer in the admin list and can open with none ticked
trigger: Filter Recent actions by one admin, remove that admin's rights, reopen the filter box.
effect: The stored filter has stored_admins=[X] but all_admins excludes X, so draft.admins is empty: 'All admins' and every admin box show unticked and Save is disabled until the user ticks something, while the log still filters by X.
fix: Keep stored ids in the draft even when they are not in the current list, or treat an empty intersection as 'all admins'.

title: Folder editor closes and toasts 'Folder updated/created' when the request is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: Open Edit Folder (or New Folder), choose a state the server refuses (name TDLib rejects, a limit the local check does not know such as FILTER_*_TOO_MUCH / DIALOG_FILTERS_TOO_MUCH, or go offline), press Save.
effect: save_folder_editor sets folders.editor = None and shows the silent 'Folder updated' note as soon as driver.edit_chat_folder/create_chat_folder returns Ok(request id). The failure arrives later through state::domains::chat_list::error (limit box or generic error) after the editor and its typed input are gone, so the person sees a success note followed by an error and loses the edits.
fix: Keep the editor as a Saving(request) stage of one enum (Editing, Saving(RequestId), Failed(text)); close it only on the matching answer and show the error inside it.

title: FolderEditor saves a snapshot of the folder spec taken when the box opened, overwriting later pin/include/exclude changes
trigger: Open Edit Folder (getChatFolder answered, editor prefilled from_spec), then while the box is open the folder changes (a chat is pinned in the folder from another window or device, a chat is removed through the remove-from-folder chain, the shared folder adds chats), then press Save.
effect: to_spec sends the old pinned_chat_ids, included/excluded sets and color_id in editChatFolder, silently undoing the newer change. ChatList already tracks folder_specs_stale so edits start from a fresh spec for removals, but the editor ignores it.
fix: Store the editor's base spec with its fetch generation as part of one stage enum and, on Save, refetch (or merge only the fields the person touched) when folder_specs_stale contains the folder.

title: Archive build error note is shown in whatever chat is open, and the 'Preparing the archive' note is never settled when the person moved on
trigger: Drop a large folder on the 'Send as archive' zone in chat A, switch to chat B (same account) before zipping ends and let the build fail (too large, unreadable file), or let it succeed.
effect: archive_ready checks send_slot() only in the Ok arm; the Err arm sets an error StatusNote for the current chat B, and the Ok-but-moved-on early return leaves the earlier 'Preparing the archive' note unreplaced until it times out. No in-flight marker exists, so a second drop starts a second zip.
fix: Make the archive job a stage value keyed by SendSlot (Building(slot) -> Ready/Failed) owned by the slot's composer state, and apply both arms only when the key still matches.

title: SendGiftState keeps the gift list and the send as bools and Options in step by hand
trigger: Open Send a Gift, pick a gift, press Send, close and reopen.
effect: gifts_loading/gifts_loaded/error, premium_loaded (written, never read), sending + request + done + open are separate fields; both loaded/loading and error can be set.
fix: Fetch<Vec<AvailableGift>> for the list, Fetch for premium options, and enum SendStage { Idle, Sending(RequestId), Sent(String), Failed(String) }.

title: GiftManageState holds one-shot results and ask-once flags as bools and Options
trigger: Delete, transfer, or export a gift; open another gifts list.
effect: limits_asked (set before its requests), collections_loading/collections_stale, deleted, export_unlocked, export_url, transferred are hand-kept flags/hand-offs; reset_for_owner clears only some of them.
fix: Fetch<Limits> and Fetch<Vec<GiftCollection>> keyed by owner; one-shot results as an event queue Vec<GiftEvent> drained by the window that hosts the box.

title: ResaleSearch stage is loading + loaded + error + request_id
trigger: Open a gift's resale list, change a filter, scroll for more.
effect: loading/loaded/error are independent; request_id is a bare u64 and 0 means none; a failed load-more sets loaded=true with error and keeps next_offset.
fix: enum SearchStage { Idle, Loading { request: RequestId, page }, Ready, Failed(String) } inside the search.

title: ResaleBuy purchase stage is sending + done + request + price_changed
trigger: Buy a listing, answer arrives or the price changed.
effect: sending, done (set then the whole buy is dropped on the same line, so never read), request (0 = none) and price_changed are kept in step by hand.
fix: enum BuyStage { View, Send, Confirm, Paying { request: RequestId }, Repriced(GiftPrice) }; drop done.

title: CraftSession stage is candidates_loading/loaded/request plus crafting/craft_request/result
trigger: Open the craft box, load candidates, craft, close.
effect: Two parallel lifecycles (candidate paging and the craft itself) each use a bool plus a bare u64 request id and an Option result.
fix: Fetch<Candidates> and enum CraftStage { Choosing, Crafting(RequestId), Done(CraftResult) }.

title: Auction open is auction_request + auction_loading + auction_ready (+ GiftMarketUi::pending_auction + bidding)
trigger: Tap an auction tile or link, then another before the first answers; place a bid.
effect: Four fields across Session and UI must change together; bidding is a bare Option<i64> not tied to a request id.
fix: One enum AuctionOpen { Idle, Loading { request }, Ready(gift_id) } and Bid { Idle, Placing { request, gift_id } }.

title: AwardMembers stage is loading + done + error + generation
trigger: Open Choose members, type a search, scroll.
effect: loading, done and error can be set together; generation matches answers (good) but the stage is still flags.
fix: enum MembersStage { Loading, Ready, Failed(String), Done } with the generation beside it.

title: A finished gift transfer reports the contact of the picker's current stage, not of the request
trigger: Transfer a collectible to Ann (confirm). While transferGift is out, press Cancel (allowed: back() only refuses during export), pick Bob so the picker shows Confirm for Bob; the answer for Ann arrives.
effect: The toast says the gift went to Bob and Quill opens Bob's chat; if the picker was left on the list or closed, no toast and no chat at all. The gift went to Ann.
fix: Keep the recipient in the in-flight request (PaymentsPurpose::TransferGift { user_id, gift_name }) and build GiftTransferred from it, or make the picker stage Transferring { user_id } that back() refuses.

title: Starting another purchase (or opening another resale) overwrites a buy whose sendResoldGift is still out
trigger: Confirm a resale purchase (sending=true), press Back (after_market_pop keeps a sending buy), tap a second listing in the still open Resale list, or open another gift's resale list (market.buy = None).
effect: The first purchase's answer is dropped (buy.request mismatch): Stars are spent but no 'Gift Sent' toast, the listing stays in the list, a craft purchase never fills its slot, and a failure is silent.
fix: Keep in-flight purchases as Vec<ResaleBuy> keyed by request id, or refuse start_gift_resale_buy/open_gift_resale while a buy is sending.

title: Esc or close during the forge drops the craft session and the craft's outcome
trigger: Press Craft (craftGift sent, gifts burn), then Escape or the dialog close button while the forge animation runs.
effect: market_back pops the Craft box, after_craft_pop sets market.craft = None; the CraftResult answer is filtered out (craft_request mismatch), so the user never learns whether the craft succeeded or the gifts were lost.
fix: Refuse the pop while craft.crafting (CraftStage::Crafting), or keep the session until its answer and show the result as a toast when the box is gone.

title: Errors of resale search, auction state and craft candidates are not matched to the request that failed
trigger: Change a resale filter twice quickly (or tap auction A then auction B, or reopen the craft box) while the older request fails.
effect: The older error clears loading on the newer search (search.loading / auction_loading / candidates_loading), marks loaded with an error, and for auctions clears pending_auction so B's box never opens; a resale error also hits the craft market search when both are loading.
fix: Compare the failed request id with request_id / auction_request / candidates_request before touching the stage, as the Buy and Craft arms already do.

title: followed is set before openGiftAuction is sent and a failed follow is never retried
trigger: Open an auction bid box while the connection drops (send error or TdError on openGiftAuction).
effect: gift_market.followed stays Some(new) so the per-frame follow_gift_auction(same) returns early forever: the bid box never receives live updates, and OpenAuction/CloseAuction errors are ignored in apply_gift_market_error.
fix: enum Follow { None, Opening(gift_id), Following(gift_id) } that returns to None on the error arm so the next frame retries.

title: limits_asked is set before the limit requests and never cleared when they fail
trigger: Open a gifts list when getOption sends fail (offline moment); GetGiftOption errors are swallowed.
effect: For the rest of the session pin/collection/resale limits stay at their defaults and are never asked again.
fix: Fetch<GiftLimits>: Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed with retry on the next gifts open.

title: getGiftCollections answer is applied to whichever owner's list is open
trigger: Open your own gifts, then at once a channel's gifts (reset_for_owner + new fetch); the first fetch answers after the second.
effect: Collection tabs of the wrong owner show (and collections_loading drops early); picking one asks the channel for a collection id that is not its own.
fix: Carry the owner in PaymentsPurpose::GetGiftCollections and apply only when it equals hub.gifts_owner.

title: Closing Send a Gift while sendGift is out loses its result
trigger: Press Send on a Stars gift, close the dialog before the answer.
effect: close_send_gift clears done/error but leaves sending/request; the OK sets done on a closed dialog and an error is never shown, so the user is not told whether Stars were spent.
fix: SendStage::Sending(request) that closing keeps, with the answer posted as a toast (ok or error) when the dialog is no longer open.

title: Require Monthly Fee can be switched on while editing an ordinary link and Save then wipes its limits
trigger: In a private channel edit an existing normal invite link, switch on Require Monthly Fee, press Save.
effect: offers_subscription ignores editing, so request() falls to InviteLinkRequest::Edit with expiration 0, member_limit 0 and no approval: the link silently loses its expiry, usage limit and approval and no fee is created.
fix: offers_subscription returns false when link.is_some() and locked_stars is None (tdesktop offers it for new links only).

title: getGiftUpgradePreview is re-sent on every build of the auction info box after an error
trigger: Open an auction info box while getGiftUpgradePreview keeps failing.
effect: fetch_gift_upgrade_preview is called from the dialog body builder; a failed answer inserts nothing into previews, so each rebuild (at least once a second via request_animation_tick) sends the request again.
fix: previews: HashMap<gift_id, Fetch<UpgradePreview>> so Failed is not retried until reopened, and ask from the opener not the builder.

title: One-shot gift results (deleted, transferred, export_url) are consumed by whichever window runs the transfer upkeep
trigger: Delete or transfer a gift from a gifts box hosted in a chat window.
effect: deleted/transferred/export_url sit in the Session until a window whose dialog_may_show_in(GiftTransfer) runs gift_transfer_frame_upkeep; the toast, Fragment page or the recipient's chat may open in the main window or late; reset_for_owner leaves them set.
fix: Post these as events naming the asking window and clear them in reset_for_owner.

title: Linux launcher badge push is marked sent although the worker may drop it
trigger: Start Quill with no dock/session bus ready, or let the bus connection fail once while unread stays the same.
effect: push_badge returns true after LAUNCHER_SLOT.put, so LAST_SENT records the count; the worker drops it when Connection::session() fails or emit_signal errors and the badge stays wrong until the count changes or the app is re-activated.
fix: Have the worker report success back (AtomicBool) so LAST_SENT is set only after a successful emit.

title: Media cache scope is a process-wide OnceLock set by the first account's connect; every later account (switch, background) shares it
trigger: Sign in account A, add account B, switch to B (plan_restore runs for B and calls set_media_cache_scope(B), which is ignored). Play a webm sticker, record a voice note or drop an archive in B.
effect: B's decrypted scratch (gif-frames/<file_id>, captures, video-note-thumbs, archives, file-thumbs) goes under quill-media-cache/<A>; file ids overlap across accounts so discard_frame_cache(file_id) in one account removes the other's extraction dir. The doc claim 'account-scoped' is false once a second account connects.
fix: Drop the global; take the scope from the account on screen (AccountKey in the caller or a per-OnScreen cache base) so the base is replaced with the account.

title: sweep_media_caches wipes every account's scratch (and clears the verdict/ensured-dir memos) when one account logs out
trigger: Two accounts signed in, B playing a webm sticker or recording a voice note; account A is logged out remotely (restart_live_connection calls sweep_media_caches).
effect: B's in-flight frame extraction or capture directory is renamed away under it; the sticker/clip stays blank or the recording write fails until reopened.
fix: Sweep only the logged-out account's scoped base (needs the per-account scope of the previous finding).

title: ensure_private_dir remembers a directory as created once per process; nothing notices the directory being removed
trigger: Quill runs for days; the OS temp cleaner removes quill-media-cache/<account>/gif-frames; render paths call ensure_private_dir every frame.
effect: The dir is never recreated (ENSURED_DIRS says done), so every extraction/capture under it fails until the next sweep or restart.
fix: Check existence cheaply on failure (retry after forgetting the entry) or key the entry to a sweep generation.

title: Venue search generation restarts at 0 for every opened picker, so a late answer of a closed picker is accepted by the next one
trigger: Open Send Location, pan/search so a getInlineQueryResults is in flight (generation N), close the box, reopen Send Location in the same or another chat and make the same number of venue queries (generation N again) before the old answer lands.
effect: venues_answered matches only on generation, so the old picker's venues (another place or chat) appear and are cached under the new picker's request point.
fix: Make the generation a LocationSharing-wide counter that is never reset (or carry a picker id in the purpose and compare chat_id and point).

title: VenueBot::Resolving has no exit except an answer; open() resets only Failed
trigger: Open Send Location with the venue bot not yet resolved, drop the searchPublicChat request (connection restart / request purge) or have it answered before the bot user is cached (then Missing is final).
effect: Venue list stays on Loading (Resolving arm sends nothing) for every later picker of the session, or shows no venues for the whole session after Missing.
fix: Reset Resolving and Missing to Unknown in open() (as Failed is), and when the session's requests are dropped.

title: Venue icon state is sticky: Failed is never retried and Requested never leaves if the answer is dropped
trigger: A venue icon request errors once (FLOOD_WAIT, offline) or its answer is dropped.
effect: That category shows no icon for the rest of the session (icons is cleared only at 256 entries).
fix: Forget Failed/Requested entries when a picker opens.

title: VenueSearch stage is list (VenueList) plus needs_send, debounce and request kept in step by hand; Address is resolving_for/postponed/job/hidden_while_moving; moving and places_in_area are separate bools
trigger: n/a (every pan, zoom, search keystroke and answer edits several of them)
effect: No bug today; a request in flight is only 'needs_send == false && list == Loading'.
fix: One enum per concern: VenueQuery { Idle, Waiting(debounce), ToSend, InFlight(generation), Done } and AddressState { Hidden, Postponed(p), Resolving(p), Shown(text) }.

title: CommentsTracker keeps state, has, last_id and last_read_id in step by hand
trigger: n/a (new comments, toggle, pinned-comment click)
effect: No bug on the main paths; set_has returns early when has is unchanged so state is only corrected by the next change.
fix: Fold has into CommentsState (Shown{..}, Hidden{unread: bool}, Empty) so one value carries the stage.

title: show_from_pinned shows the list but does not mark comments read or clear has=WithUnread
trigger: Comments toggle shows the dot (WithNew); click a pinned comment (list opens); close the list again with the toggle.
effect: last_read_id and has stay stale, so on_messages (hidden) computes 'unread' from old ids and the dot can come back for comments already seen when has changes.
fix: Make show_from_pinned go through the same transition as toggle to Shown.

title: AddPendingReaction error after the pending Stars were already committed leaves committed_stars inflated; CommitPendingReactions error zeroes all batches
trigger: Tap Stars on a live story, the addPendingLiveStoryReaction error arrives after the 5.5 s commit tick (slow network), or two commits are in flight and one fails.
effect: The Stars button total keeps showing Stars that were not added (until a donors update), or drops other committed batches from the total.
fix: Track each batch with its request id (AddPending/Commit carry stars) and undo exactly that batch's stars from whichever bucket holds it.

title: A deleted string in updateLanguagePackStrings clears the key to English, dropping the base pack and community overlay layers
trigger: Using a pack with a base pack or a Quill community overlay; Telegram deletes one of its strings (patched with Deleted).
effect: That string shows in English (or empty fall-through) instead of the base pack's/overlay's text until the pack is reloaded.
fix: Keep layers separate (overlay, base, pack) and recompute the key from the lower layers on delete.

title: OPENED/FORGOTTEN are process-wide once-cells for the first account's key, while open() reloads layouts on every connect
trigger: Launch on account A, switch to B (connect_ui calls open for B; OPENED stays A), log out A before the first chat list draw, or just run on B.
effect: B's line layouts are never saved to its own file (A's key/file is used) and a logged-out account's FORGOTTEN flag covers only the first file; cold starts of B stay un-prewarmed.
fix: Key the file by the account on screen at save time (replace the OnceLock with the live LinesFile).

title: Process-wide CACHE + GENERATION + REFRESHING (+ the UI's WATCHING flag) form a fetch stage kept by hand
trigger: n/a (Settings > System draws state(); a stale answer starts a thread; the UI polls refreshing() every 100 ms)
effect: No bug found: RefreshDone clears REFRESHING on panic and spawn failure. A read that never returns (wedged xdg-mime/registry without the timeout) would leave REFRESHING true forever.
fix: One Fetch<LinkHandlerState> cell with Idle/Loading{gen}/Ready/Stale.

title: Venue search stage is five fields kept in step by hand
trigger: open picker, type in the search field, pause, close search, move the map
effect: none today; stage is spread over needs_send, debounce, search_shown, generation, request and list
fix: One enum for the venue query: Idle, Debouncing{query}, Wanted{generation,point,query}, InFlight{generation,..}, Answered, Failed; list derived from it.

title: Address lookup stage is resolving_for, job, postponed, hidden_while_moving, shown_once and moving
trigger: drag the pin, release, wait for the address, drag again
effect: none today; the address shown depends on which of five fields is set
fix: An enum Address { Hidden, Postponed(point), Resolving(point), Shown{point,text}, HiddenWhileMoving{point,text} } owned by the picker, with moving as part of the pin state.

title: Closing the venue search after a failed list lookup leaves the venue list on Loading
trigger: Open Send Location while the venue bot lookup fails (offline or bot error, list shows nothing found), type one letter in the search field, close the search within 900 ms
effect: The venue list shows the loading spinner and nothing is pending; it stays until the map is moved or Places in this area is pressed
fix: On search close, always re-request or restore the last list; a failed lookup must clear request so request_venues does not early-return, or cache a Failed entry; derive list from one query stage enum.

title: A slow address lookup can show the previous place's address under the new pin
trigger: Rest the pin at A (address shown), drag to B and rest 3 s so the lookup starts, drag slightly again before it answers and release within the same place
effect: hidden_while_moving still holds A's address (it is only cleared when restored) and move_ended shows it for B until the lookup answers
fix: Key the hidden text by the point it was resolved for (Shown{point,text}) so it is restored only for that point.

title: GiftPurchase stage is loading, sending, completed bools beside quote, price and note
trigger: Open a Marketplace gift, load a name, buy it
effect: none found today; Stars/TON money flow rests on loading/sending/completed staying exclusive and on the UI separately holding marketplace_open
fix: enum GiftPurchaseStage { Loading, Quoted{quote,price}, Sending{price}, Sent, Failed(note) } held by the session; the note derived from the stage.

title: Space-hold boost is pressed_at, last_seen and active kept together
trigger: Hold Space in the media viewer video, or lose the key-up to another window
effect: none today (stale press is timed out and cancel clears it)
fix: enum Boost { Idle, Armed{since,last_seen}, Boosting{last_seen} }.

title: An OS media key pressed while nothing plays is queued and replayed on the next track
trigger: Play a voice note or song, let it end (or close the bar), press the media key or playerctl play-pause (macOS remote commands and MPRIS stay registered), then start another voice note minutes later
effect: The queued Toggle or Pause lands on the first playback tick and pauses or stops the new track at once; a queued Next skips
fix: Drop commands when no player owns the session (take_commands in the inactive branch of the playback tick, or stamp each command with the time and ignore old ones); keep a CommandQueue owned by the active player.

title: Tray notifications and sounds toggles still work under the passcode lock
trigger: Lock Quill with a passcode, click Disable notifications or Disable notification sounds in the tray menu
effect: The setting is saved and notifications stop while locked; tdesktop hides the toggle under the lock (lock-is-a-render-state.md)
fix: Test refused_while_locked in the tray action loop (or hide the items while locked) and list the step in scripts/lock-surfaces.txt.

title: Any getMessageEffect error (rate limit, network, timeout) marks the effect gone for the whole session
trigger: Open a private chat that has messages sent with effects while the connection is flaky or TDLib answers 429 to getMessageEffect; the error arm in state/domains/stickers/error.rs:21 calls MessageEffects::fail(id) for every TdError without looking at the code.
effect: The effect id sits in `failed` for the life of the Session: wanted() never asks again, is_gone() makes message_effects_pass drop the waiting play, the badge never gets its icon and the effect never plays, until the account is re-added. The message was already marked watched, so it is lost for good.
fix: Hold each effect as Fetch<MessageEffect> (idle, loading, ready, failed) where only a real not-found is a terminal Gone and other errors return to idle so the next frame can ask again.

title: load_message_effects marks an id requested before the send; a failed send or dropped answer leaves it requested forever
trigger: Open a chat with effect messages while the JSON sender fails (channel closed during a reconnect) or the request is dropped without an answer or error; mark_requested(effect_id) already ran and the `?` on send_json_request returns early.
effect: wanted() filters on `requested`, so that effect and the ids after it in the loop are never asked for again: no badge icon, no effect, and the send-menu picker cell never loads, until restart.
fix: Make `requested` part of a per-id Fetch stage set only after the send succeeded, and leave Loading on the error arm, a dropped request and a reconnect.

title: Per-effect fetch stage is spread over by_id, requested and failed
trigger: n/a: accept(), fail() and mark_requested() each have to remove the id from the other sets by hand.
effect: An id can be in requested and failed, or in by_id and failed, if a writer is added that forgets one removal; wanted() has to test all three.
fix: HashMap<i64, Fetch<MessageEffect>> (src/state/fetch.rs) as the single record per effect id.

title: A message's effect stage (unwatched, watched, unknown) is two key sets kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a: note(), renamed() and mark_watched() consult `watched` and `unwatched` together; renamed() moves only unwatched, and a key's stage is the combination of two memberships.
effect: Both sets are cleared independently when full (BoundedKeys::insert), so a stage can silently revert to unknown and a message can replay or never play.
fix: HashMap<MessageKey, EffectStage> with Unwatched and Watched variants and one eviction policy.

title: BoundedKeys clears the whole set at 16384 keys, which replays played effects and drops unplayed ones
trigger: A long session with many effect messages (or a busy chat history paged repeatedly) fills `watched`; the next insert clears it, and a history page that re-notes an incoming unread effect message makes it unwatched again, so it plays a second time. Filling `unwatched` first drops effects that never played.
effect: An effect replays on its own after scrolling back, or a sent or unread effect never plays.
fix: Evict the oldest keys (an LRU or a per-chat map dropped with the chat) instead of clearing everything.

title: WAITING is a process-wide thread-local keyed by bare (chat, message) with no account or window
trigger: Ask for a message effect in a private chat with contact X on account A (WAITING gets an entry for up to 30 s), switch to account B within that time and open the chat with the same contact (private chat ids equal user ids), where a message has the same numeric id and a drawn badge.
effect: retain() keeps the entry because the chat id is in B's shown set and badge::seen(key) is true, so A's effect id plays over B's message (or its lookup is asked on B's session).
fix: Hold the waiting list in OnScreen (per account, per window slot) and key it by ChatMessage; it then goes with the screen.

title: Swipe indicator shows 'reached' after backing off slightly, but releasing does not step
trigger: Trackpad swipe past the threshold so the arrow is fully in, then pull back 1 to 2 px (ratio 0.96..0.99) and let go.
effect: pull_to keeps `reached` true until ratio drops under 0.95 (indicator() draws the armed arrow), but end() steps only when ratio() >= 1.0, so the arrow says 'let go to move' and nothing moves.
fix: Decide the step from the same armed value the indicator shows (end() uses pull.reached), or drop the stored bool and derive both from one function.

title: One trackpad gesture is tracked by two machines (SwipeNav::gesture and WheelNav accum plus spent_at) handed off by a returned bool
trigger: n/a: ui/media_viewer/navigation.rs viewer_scroll_wheel runs viewer_swipe first and skips WheelNav when it returns true, so WheelNav::spent_at and SwipeNav::gesture must agree on when a gesture started, ended or moved an item.
effect: No bug today; WheelNav::spent_at (an Option used as a 'gesture already moved' flag) is not refreshed for captured events, and the two must be reset together by new_item() on every item change and by nothing on viewer close.
fix: One TrackpadGesture enum (Idle, Undecided, Swiping, Scrolling, Spent, Released) owned by the viewer that both the swipe and the scroll step read.

title: Media file stage in MediaFacts is downloading and local bools plus Option<bool> tri-states
trigger: n/a: menu_media_facts (ui/message_menu_ui/mod.rs:208) builds downloading and local from two unrelated lookups, so both can be true (a re-download of a local file); media_actions then offers only Cancel Download and hides Show in Folder and Save As.
effect: The menu for a file that is on disk and being fetched again offers only Cancel Download; the favorite, gif_saved and in_profile Options mean 'unknown until loaded' beside a bool, a second pair of states.
fix: A MediaFile enum (Remote, Downloading, Local) and a Known<bool> for the loaded-later facts, built once from the session's file record.
